getUserDetails: SELECT id, username, password, api_key, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ollama_users WHERE username = %s
registerUsers: INSERT INTO ollama_users (username, password) VALUES (%s, %s) RETURNING id, username, status, created_at, updated_at;
getAllUsers: SELECT id, username, password, api_key, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ollama_users;
